cards.title: Publish fork-owned CI checks
cards.summary: PR #2 has no published checks. Preserve upstream workflows and check names while configuring fork-owned execution for this public repository; the private self-hosted runner policy does not enroll this fork. Source: PR #2 local QA at 0626934371; docs/fork/maintenance.md. Deferred by the owner's request to ship PR #2 with these known gaps.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Inventory required checks and fork-accessible runner/release dependencies without weakening upstream tests.
Run the applicable CI jobs on a PR and publish native checks bound to the tested head.
Document public-fork runner ownership and ensure private credentials and upstream release services are not assumed.

cards.title: Complete package and server CI in a reproducible environment
cards.summary: The package sweep failed on Mac filesystem/socket/tar/path differences. The cached server sweep failed on machine-global Git URL rewriting; two direct full-server attempts were interrupted. Focused diagnostic passes do not establish a full pass. Source: PR #2 local QA at f0f304ebdf2. Deferred by the owner's request to ship PR #2 with these known gaps.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Provide a documented Linux ARM64 or equivalent supported CI environment with required system tools and case-sensitive paths.
Isolate test Git configuration and preserve that isolation through cached-test subprocesses without changing personal Git settings.
Complete the full applicable package and server suites, retain original failures, and distinguish environment failures from product regressions.

cards.title: Resolve remaining browser-suite failures
cards.summary: Full web sweep: 503/509 files and 5445/5450 tests passed, with five test failures and two import-suite errors. Focused import diagnostics passed; four failures remained across FilePreviewPanel, fileEditorDismissal and GuestPage. Source files are unchanged from main, but a baseline comparison is still needed. Source: PR #2 local QA at f0f304ebdf2. Deferred by the owner's request to ship PR #2 with these known gaps.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Reproduce the EPUB/output-budget, editor-selection and follow-end-scroll failures against both the shipped feature and its main baseline under the same browser/worker settings.
Fix confirmed regressions at the responsible layer with behavioral proof; classify environment-only failures using preserved diagnostics.
Complete the web suite successfully without adding retries, per-test timeouts, unreasoned skips or weakened assertions.

cards.title: Finish native and final-source workflow QA
cards.summary: Web QA covered 23 captures on 52fe82b393. The real Luna workflow completed on b54202e6 with corrective handoffs; autonomous completion after the fixes remains unverified. No native Electron interaction or mobile-device pass was completed. iOS inventory was empty and Android SDK unavailable. Source: PR #2 QA evidence comment. Deferred by the owner's request to ship PR #2 with these known gaps.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Provision an available device through the supported Device workflow and test mobile monitoring, evidence, questions and lifecycle controls on iOS and Android.
Run an integrated Electron client pass and a fresh Planner → Builder → independent Reviewer fixture on the final source without corrective human protocol handoffs.
Capture authenticated empty, populated, error, message, lifecycle and narrow states with an exact-source manifest, inspect them visually, and publish the complete evidence bundle.

cards.title: Diagnose the remaining Claude native-eval fixture error
cards.summary: Final native evals on clean 0626934371: Codex 16/16; Claude 15/16. One WF-REVIEWER sample failed with Unsupported native fixture shell operator. This is a failed sample, not a model-behavior pass. Source: PR #2 validation. Deferred by the owner's request to ship PR #2 with these known gaps.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Preserve the failing tool attempt and identify the exact unsupported command without exposing subscription credentials or running it on the host.
If the command is legitimate, represent its behavior through a bounded deterministic fixture; otherwise return an actionable refusal and evaluate model recovery.
Add a failing regression for the diagnosed cause and rerun the eight workflow cases on both native providers, retaining all attempts and counting infrastructure errors as failures.

cards.title: Resolve the agent context budget increase
cards.summary: The ten workflow tools increase the measured MCP catalog from 47538 to 56626 bytes (+9088). The inherited Agent Context Budget workflow requires explicit maintainer approval for growth. No approval label or green check was fabricated for PR #2. Source: apps/server/src/provider/agentContextBudget.json and .github/workflows/agent-context-budget.yml. Deferred by the owner's request to ship PR #2 with these known gaps.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Assess whether existing tool/schema text can be reduced while preserving contracts, useful errors and provider behavior.
Keep the measured budget file equal to the actual catalog and rerun the instruction/tool evals for any text change.
Record maintainer acceptance of any remaining growth through the existing policy, or reduce the catalog to pass without an exception.
